text:
Question regarding opening a joint account B1 visa. 

Today we went to Hapoalim in RG and were told that due to a tax policy they can’t do it. 
Then we went to Leumi and they told us that my partner needed a second identification from Mali, his country. Unfortunately, we don’t have his ID card and it’s very difficult to get. 

Does anyone know of any banks or branches where it’s possible to open a joint account without a second identification for the foreign partner?
